method: This annual North American ranking combines client and employee satisfaction surveys. The 2026 award covers the previous calendar year. Qualifying participants completed at least two client and two employee surveys each month for 12 months. Exact respondent counts and separate client means were not published on the ranking pages. The rank describes participating agencies; it is not a client-only rating.
